notes.title: Changelog 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we have some additional fixes to share, this time they are related to the ice mages! Enjoy the notes :)

[h2]Changelog 1.1.2[/h2]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing blizzards to not cause their respective effects in some situations.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing some enemies to slide instead of staying still when frozen by an ice mage.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing some enemies to become immune when hit by multiple fire and ice mages simultaneously.
[/list]

And that's all! These bugs were hard to track, but now they don't exist anymore :D. Have fun and let's save some timelines!

-Rodri

notes.title: Changelog 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we are releasing our first version of the year, a little patch to say hi to 2025 :)

Here are the notes!

[h2]Changelog V. 1.1.1[/h2] What a number! :o

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this is the first big update of Iconia Defenders since launch! We gathered your feedback and implemented some cool stuff, take a look at the notes!

[h2]Changelog 1.1.0[/h2]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] New settings screen design!
[*] You can now change the game's font in the Settings screen! Between "Classic" (Norse font) and "Roboto", choose the one you prefer for better readability. It will be set as "Robot" by default as we really loved the final result :).
[*] We added a new option in the settings screen: "Preview paths", that enables/disables the enemy paths' previews. Enabled by default.
[*] We added a new option in the settings screen: "Damage numbers", that enables/disables the damage caused floating texts, good if you prefer a cleaner experience. Enabled by default.
[*] If the player is playing a card, pressing ESC will now cancel such action instead of opening the menu overlay. (if there is no action in progress, it will open the menu just as before).
[*] Popups opened in the skill tree can now be closed by pressing ESC.
[*] Recycled towers now keep their previous target mode when placed again.
[*] The mouse cursor is now highlighted with golden borders in the cemetery and inferno stages so it is easier to see! (waves 15 to 40).
[*] Updated Unity version from 2022.3.22f1 to 2022.3.54f1 which includes many stability improvements and crash fixes.
[/list]
[h3]New settings screen with the new font selected[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/99ddda61258c3a3934a7e36b062666743a31f08e.png[/img]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced "cursed architect" superior gem stock from 6 to 4.
[*] Reduced "purge" superior gem stock from 5 to 3.
[*] In Endless mode and after the final boss is defeated, the cursed gems selector will appear every even wave instead of every 3 waves (don't worry, it is still possible to beat those highscores!).
[*] Removed infinite gems that added attack speed to the towers (this change affects saved games, if you had any they will be ignored).
[*] Limited the amount of mini boss spawners to 4 at the same time. This affects the endless mode.
[*] The "Teleportation" cursed gem can now teleport creeps through walls and towers (randomly), but it will not appear before wave 9.
[*] Arcane-Legacy skill series damage per arcane mage in map reduced from +20/34 to +8/12, +42/54 to +16/22, and +60/82 to +30/42, respectively.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing some cards under specific conditions to not be added to the player's discard pile when receiving them via superior gems.
[*] Fixed some Italian and French translations
[*] Controls UI will not appear on top of the superior gems selection screen anymore.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "start wave" button where it was being displayed even when all the portals didn't appear yet.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the enemies's path preview to stay on the map even when the wave was started.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the "Magic Masters" superior gem to apply its effect to Archers instead of Arcane mages.
[*] Fixed some texts that were telling "+x% attack damage" instead of "+x% base damage".
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the towers to not be affected by the run modifiers when reloading a game.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the towers' price run modifiers to be applied only to the first tower placed of every card, and not on the following prices. Now the impact of "Cheaper towers" and "More expensive towers" is bigger (the % is still the same).
[*] Tower's range preview now displays correctly the tower's range when there is a run modifier affecting it.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] The tower upgraded effect animation's interval is reduced when having 20, 40, and 60 towers or more (For example when picking a superior gem that increases towers' attack). Also, the animation is now affected by game speed.
[*] Increased the opacity of the enemies' paths. They will also be dark again on the latest stage instead of white.
[*] Various optimization improvements. Specially for late game. Details:
[list] [*] Disabled various cached objects while not being used.
[*] Implemented object pooling on various particle systems, also on creeps, projectiles, etc.
[*] Removed Debug.Log lines (this actually caused a big impact).
[*] Updated many of the game sounds to activate via events instead of on-demand instantiation.
[*] Various processes were moved from the main thread to a multi-threaded architecture. For example, the tower's target adquisition system was recreated from scratch to be not only simpler but also to use multiple threads and work in background.
[*] To give an idea of the impact: with 170+ towers on map I went from 1 FPS to 60 FPS. The end results will depend on your computer, but the difference is highly noticeable!.
[/list][/list]

Thank you very much to everyone for all your feedback! Specially to our discord members who constantly contributed to the game improvement!

-Rodri

notes.title: Version 0.9.2: The Timelines Update - is here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Today is the begining of the Steam Next Fest! And to celebrate, we have come with a big update for the demo! Which adds lots of interesting content, fixes and balancing improvements.

Let's dive into the details!

[h2]Changelog: 0.9.2[/h2]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Branch (timeline) selection is now available whenever we start a new run!
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/b56092ef2f69b726b2fdd4e1e30ea8fd2704fba3.gif[/img]
    Every time you start a new run, you will be able to choose a branch to start on. Branches can have random modifiers chosen from a curated list. 
    In addition to that, they will always have 2 base modifiers that determines the base difficulty of the branch. You can think of it as the base difficulty, like "easy", "regular", and "hard".
    There will be up to 3 branches on the full game (easy, regular, & hard), only the first 2 branches will be available on the demo.
    We also added a mini tutorial when you see the screen for the first time.
[*] New spell card! Recycle: allows to remove a tower from the map and puts it back on your hand, you can place the tower again for free. It is very useful for moving towers that weren't well positioned. The tower keeps its level and it is reflected in the tower's card (when greater than lv 1).
[*] New rare superior gem! Recycling love: Gives 1 recycle spell card. It can be picked up to 2 times.
[*] The Recycle spell can be obtained on the skill tree as a starter card. It replaced the Demolish spell, and the Demolish spell replaced the Discard spell. 
[*] The Discard spell is not more available as a starting card. However it can still be obtained via superior gems. Up to 2 times.
[*] Added a micro tutorial for the deck building screen.
[*] Towers stunned by Bharisia have a new animation! It is clearer to understand and more consistent with the game's overall art style.
[*] New mini boss added: Mega bat. 2 Mega bats will appear at wave 12 and fly around the player's base. Defeat them before they reach the extractor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/9dfd2e21ebd5b57bef20ecbd53b02991e147d4dc.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] the "regular" difficulty (which was the only difficulty before this version) will now give +50% gems, applied to both the extracted gems and gems obtained from creeps. The base value for gems extraction is now 100 (so, playing in "regular difficulty" will give you 150 per wave).
[*] Players can now choose the "easy" difficulty, which provides less stats to the enemies. Sometimes due to random modifiers, the normal branch may become easier than the easy one, if you have enough luck!
[*] There will be a "hard" difficulty (the third branch), but it will not be available during the demo. And it will require a [i][b]boss trophy[/b][/i] to unlock. What's that? You will hear about it soon...
[*] Increased Bharisia's attack range from 500 to 600 when she is flying.
[*] Increased Bharisia's attack range from 400 to 500 when she is walking.
[*] Increased Bharisia's maximum targets from 2 to 3 when she is walking (flying was already 3).
[*] Increased Bharisia's attack interval from 6 seconds to a random value between 6 and 7. Both flying and walking.
[*] Bharisia's magic resistance increased from 50% to 60%. (ground and flying)
[*] Walking Bharisia's gold loot increased from 600 to 1000. She now provides 150 gems and 2000 score points.
[*] Gigantism cursed gem health increase effect reduced from +40% to +25%.
[*] Dwarfism cursed gem health reduction effect increased from -10% to -15%.
[*] Shaman's health reduced from 140 to 100. Their Magic resistance was also reduced from 65% to 55%.
[*] Alpha War Wolf's health reduced from 1120 to 840. Its gold loot was increased from 325 to 650.
[*] Fixed how tower upgrade prices are calculated. Per each level the upgrade price is correctly increased by 10%. Before it was increasing exponentially.
[*] When playing a tower card its price will increase by its base price, instead of doubling the current price.
For example, an archer tower card will now cost 60 -> 120 -> 180 -> 240. Before, its cost was 60 -> 120 -> 240 -> 480.
[*] Spawners during a boss fight will re-spawn the enemies every 24 seconds instead of 6.
[*] Slime mutation does not affect flying minions anymore.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where 2x1 spell card didn't worked when there was a free tower card in the deck.
[*] Fixed the Curses cursed superior gem not giving more curses if chosen again.
[*] Fixed some superior gems that gave cards not giving another card when picked again.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing some superior gems to appear as "unlocked" even if you have never seen them.
[*] Fixed tutorial gems gained been more than what was actually displayed during the run.
[*] Fixed stats and stat upgrades displaying as 0 instead of 0.xx on non-english languages. Basically decimals were not being displayed to other languages.
[*] Fixed various texts in Spanish and Portuguese.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the wave to never end when a riflemen tower instantly destroys a creep that just spawned in a mini boss spawner.
[*] Fixed Discord link in the game.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added custom sound effects and "pff" smoke when destroying towers using the Demolish spell.
[*] The "get a tower if all card are walls" effect mentioned in a previous update will now also include spell cards and curses in consideration.
[*] Limited the game to 60 fps when Vsync is off.
[*] Bharisia attacks' effect was updated to match the new Tower stunned animation.
[*] Improved the reaction time of the player's hand. Now cards can be picked during the "draw animation", and it feels far more fluid.
[*] We are preparing the game for the tons of new content to come :)
[/list]

So that's a lot!, I hope you enjoy the new content and we would love to hear your feedback! 
Thank you for reading and God bless you all! :)

notes.title: Dev update #9 - New Tier 1 enemies! +1 mini boss for the demo & what's next.
notes.notes:
Hello hello! It is been a while since our last update about the game!, so i'm going to share a bit of what's coming for Iconia Defenders!

[h1]New Tier 1 enemies![/h1]
Now enemies are divided by tier. All the current enemies belong to tier 1. This includes minions and mini bosses. Basically, they are all the enemies that you will face before reaching the first boss. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/3d5bdd20de1e92c2d52f8b4b96b2dbc2ce7c9968.png[/img]
[i]Courtesy of [url=https://game-icons.net/]game-icons.net[/url][/i]

From left to right, prepare to face [b]Giant spiders[/b]! These creatures have a strong exoskeleton, so they are resistant to physical damage. And they will spawn [b]baby spiders[/b] when defeated! The baby spiders are weak, but they can quickly become a real threat!

Then, you may be attacked by [b]Eagles[/b]! These flying creatures have high health and are resistant to physical attacks. But they don't go straight to your Extractor like the bats, instead they will [i][b]fly in circles[/b][/i] for some time before attacking.

Last but not least, the [b]Troll Hunters[/b] are strong guys that [b][i]can sprint from time to time[/i][/b], highly increasing their movement speed for some seconds, with a fancy visual effect.

These new enemies will not be available in the demo, instead they will only appear in the full game.

[h1]New Mini boss for the demo![/h1]
At wave 12 prepare to defend from these 2 bad guys:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/9dfd2e21ebd5b57bef20ecbd53b02991e147d4dc.gif[/img]

This is our first flying miniboss! Meet the [b]Mega Bat[/b]! Inspired by the real megabats (aka fruit bats). These creatures are strong, and will fly around the player's extractor before attacking it, pretty much like the Eagles mentioned before.
This mechanic allowed us to create more interesting and tanky-er flying enemies without making the game too harsh. And allowing for different strategies to flourish.
When combined with the "Deployment Tactics" Cursed gem, they will spawn regular bats from time to time.

You will be able to fight the mega bats on our next update!

[h1]Will there be Tier 2 enemies???[/h1]
Yes! There are actually [b]16 new tier 2 enemies[/b] (including mini bosses and a new boss), which we will be presenting in a future post! To give you an idea of what to expect, they are undead-themed enemies, and will come exclusively on the full game release.

I hope you enjoyed these dev notes! And I would love to hear your feedback! Share your thoughs and opinions, and if you want to participate in the development of the game join our discord with the link below!

God bless you all and have a great week! 

- Rodri

notes.title: Development update #8 - Player's hand: Before & After
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Welcome to the 8th development update of Iconia Defenders!

In today's post, I'm going to talk about one of the features we were working on in the past, they are already available in the game, but is good to talk in retrospective and how it changed over time.

[h2]Player's hand[/h2]

Let's start with the "Player's hand". The player's hand is where the cards that you can play appears. At the left of the "Deck button".
Originally, the player's hand was very stale. All the cards were blue, walls' shapes were hard to distinguish. And we didn't have a "Discard Pile". As you can see in the following picture:
[h3]Before[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/619fa2f9ddea959ed8297eeaaff2e1e1b7ee5d23.png[/img]
Animations were also very basic...

We made many improvements on this feature, not only because it is one of the main components of the game, but also thanks to the feedbacks we received from the community.
[list]
[*] We added new artwork for the wall cards, so now you can distinguish the different shapes, amount of walls and size. Also, we wanted them to look pretty. 
[*] We defined colors for each kind of card that you can play. Spells are pink, towers are blue, walls are brown, and curses are red.
[*] In addition to that, we added a "Discard Pile" button at the left.
[*] We also added and improved the animations. Juicy it up a bit. Added screen shakes, and sounds.  
[/list] [h3]After[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/19dc92ef68f56496e78af2328bf1222dfd7eb50a.gif[/img]
[i]Sorry for the gif quality :)[/i]

Another feedback we received was about "knowing" which cards are in the deck and which ones are in the Discard Pile.
And, since we now have a Discard Pile button, we added an "onClick" feature that displays the following modal:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/0afc513e2ef58881c5d206b9850d0578b1428849.png[/img]
It will tell you how many cards are in your Discard Pile, as well as how many are on your deck. You can also see the cards in your hand below it. 
Also, if you hover over the cards in the modal, you will be able to see their details. Like the stats for the towers, spell descriptions, price, etc.

All of this was made possible thanks to the community feedback, we are all upgrading the game together, and if you are not a member of our Discord yet, what are you waiting for? Come and participate with all of us to make iconia Defenders an even greater game! 
[i]You can find a Discord button below.[/i]

Thanks for reading!! God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

- Rodri.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - The Encyclopedia update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are just releasing the update 0.8.1! These were great weeks of work, and we could implement a big feature, which took almost the entirety of the development time... the Encyclopedia!, Please take a look at the changelog. We have included some images :)

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now check the Encyclopedia! There you can find information about all the enemies, towers, walls, spells, and superior gems that you have unlocked, and all those that you didn't unlock yet. Of course, you will need to discover them before seeing their details ;D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/ca334e0d5f6763f99b73905e87ed03d624905ff7.png[/img]
We may be bringing some more details in a future post dedicated to it :). Anyways, you can try it right now!
[*] You can now see the superior gems chosen in the run! So you will not forget what you picked anymore!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/96b556041e4cbf21f2da0b0828a1a6970a6ea53d.png[/img]
[*] Previously, the extractor implosion effect was great, but it didn't feel right, because nothing happened after exploding, it was like it wasn't built at all... Well, not anymore! Now it will leave a hole of corruption after exploding! As well as some corruption energy and cracks on the ground.
[*] 2 new tips were added to the game. One about maze building that teaches a good strategy for placing walls. Which includes a picture! And another one about changing the tower's target priority.
[*] New enemy alerts and new tip alerts are now animated! This makes them look better while also calling a bit the attetion so you don't miss them ;)
[*] In addition to that, if a new tip alert wasn't clicked in 30 seconds, a cute "Click me" indicator will appear.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced swarm waves' enemies amount from 2.5x to 2x
[*] Swarm waves will now appear after wave 7 instead of 4.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with some sounds not being updated with their respective volume sliders.
[*] Fixed an issue where destroying an archer tower with the Demolish spell while having the "Quick, Give me an arrow!" skill was allowing the player to place infinite free archer towers.
[*] Fixed Bharisia's teleport VFX appearing on the ground instead of on her.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the enemies' death particle effects to not work properly when running the game at 120+ fps (come on, Unity...).
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the green texts that indicated the current cumulative sum of some statistics from the superior gem descriptions. It was confusing and sometimes didn't even reflect the real value. Also it is not needed anymore because we can see the stats directly in the towers and in the encyclopedia.
yes! You can see the base stats of the towers in the encyclopedia, but also how much you improved them with your skills!
[/list]
[h3]Why not 0.8.0?[/h3]
Well... we made a 0.8.0 release to our beta channel, but we find out there was a critical error happening on the encyclopedia under certain... cirmcustances. So we fixed the issue and made a new release. Since the 0.8.0 was taken by the bugged release, and this was a hotfix, 0.8.1 was the ideal number!

Thank you all for reading till here! We love you! Are you interested in seeing how the encyclopedia works? Download the demo and be the first one to complete the available items in the encyclopedia!

Most of these changes were made not only because they were planned, but also because of your feedback, so keep telling us what you like and what not, your ideas, whatever! Feedback plays a very important role in game development and in making this game great for everyone, specially you!
To provide feedback you can just leave a comment in this post, or filling our form here: https://forms.gle/qGX4rybiTUBhTuny5 or Join our Discord and talk with us! We mainly speak Spanish, English, and a bit of French :)

God bless you all and have a great weekend!

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 - Discard Pile and applying feedback!
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
Hello everybody! We've been hearing to your feedback and started to apply many things on the game, improving the overall experience while also adding new cool stuff!!
Here is the full changelog of the changes:

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a Discard Pile[/b]!
    - Now you can see which cards are in your discard pile, and which are on your deck (psst! They are shuffled, so it's not cheating :p)
    - This includes some fancy animations when discarding cards and refilling the deck with the discarded cards.
[*] [b]Now paths will update in real time while placing walls or towers.[/b] No more guessing where the enemies may go, yay!
[*] [b]Added various story dialogues[/b] that appear after certain runs completed or specific events (for example. when meeting the first boss, or killing the first mini boss) [b]We have also reduced the length[/b] of the current dialogues.
[*] [b]Added a Vsync option[/b] in the game settings. Enabled by default.
[*] Added a little description to explain what are the skill tree tiers' unlockables.
[*] [b]Added a button to restart progress[/b] in the game settings.
[*] [b]Added an "upgrade preview" in the tower stats[/b] when hovering the mouse over the level up button.
[*] [b]General overhaul of the tower upgrades[/b]. Now towers will update different stats across the levels instead of just damage.
    - [b]All towers:[/b] Increase the damage by a magic formula each level. (same as before) 
    - [b]Archer tower:[/b] 
[list]
[*] +1% attack speed every 3rd level
[*] +1% critic chance every 5th level
[*] +2% critic damage every 2nd level
[*] +2% attack range every 6th level
[/list]
    - [b]Arcane mage tower:[/b]
[list]
[*] +1% attack speed every 4th level
[*] +1% critic chance every 3rd level
[*] +1% double attack chance every 5th level
[*] +1% attack range every 2nd level
[/list]
    - [b]Fire mage tower:[/b]
[list]
[*] It will now display the burning damage instead of the damage received by burning enemies.
[*]        - +1% attack speed every 3rd level
[*]        - +1% burn chance every 4th level
[*]        - +0.2% burn damage every 3rd level
[*]        - +1% attack range every 2nd level
[/list]
    - [b]Ice mage tower:[/b]
[list]
[*] +1% attack speed every 5th level
[*] +0.3% chilling power every level
[*] +0.1% freeze chance every 2nd level
[*] +1% attack range every 4th level
[/list]
    - [b]Rifleman tower:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gets even more damage every level
[*] +1% attack speed every 2nd level
[*] +1% critic chance every 5th level
[*] +0.03% chance of headshot every level
[/list]
    - [b]Catapult tower:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gets even more damage every level
[*] +1% attack speed every 4th level
[*] +2% area of effect every 3rd level
[*] +0.1% stun chance every 2nd level
[/list]
[/list][h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was making **all** the enemies to have the health of the next wave instead of the current one (because each wave they become stronger). This issue was making the first waves harder than expected.
[*] Reduced Orcs' base health to 120 from 140
[*] Increased Shamans' base health to 140 from 120
[*] Reduced Goblin Chief's followers from 12 to 6
[*] Iron Arrows and Frenzy superior gems will not appear anymore during the tutorial.
[*] Players that didn't make past the first mini-boss in the tutorial (wave 3) will receive +100 bonus gems, so they can acquire up to 3 skills in the skill tree.
[*] Purge spell now removes a curse from any place, not only the hand.
[*] Skill Tree changes:
- Moved the Starting gold skill to Tier 2. 
- Moved the Gold mining skill to Tier 3.
- Moved the Extractor's health skill to Tier 1.
- Moved the 2-tiles wall card skill from Tier 1 to Tier 3, replacing the 3-tiles wall card skill.
- Increased Arcane Power's extra damage effect from 10% to 30%.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that was impeding the scroll of the skill tree when the mouse was above a skill.
[*] Fixed an issue that was making the card's details tooltip appear on the card (hiding it) instead of above it on certain screen resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue were the skill's details tooltip appeared "shrunk" right after buying another skill.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved loading times. The loading screen will **not** wait for 3 fixed seconds anymore.
[*] Reduced delay between last creep killed and extractor's extraction from 2 to 1.
[*] Reduced Run results spawn delay from 2 to 0.5. Its stats will now display a bit faster too.
[*] Improved superior gems selection screen overall animations speed.
[*] Reduced the chance of getting a hand full of walls. It is still possible to get a hand full of walls, but only if there are no towers in the deck (which means that they are in the discard pile). 
[*] Because of the item mentioned above, it is no longer possible to start a new run without a tower or spell in the hand.
[*] Updated various texts in the game to make them more descriptive, shorter, and clearer.
[*] Added a little fog effect in the ground below the portals. 
[/list]

We may make a dedicated post to go into the details of the Discard Pile and the preview of the cards in it (and in the deck), including some pictures. But in the meantime enjoy the detailed wall of text above ;D. Let us know what you think and if you have any other feedback to improve the game!

God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Demo update 0.6.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog[/h2]

Based on the feedback received, we implemented some quick QoL features and fixes.

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new User interface volume slider. So the sounds happening in the UI can be tweaked separately from the sounds of the game.
[*] Added tooltips to the deck building card counters, so they are easier to understand.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the "hover" sound not being affected by any of the volume sliders. It is now affected by the UI volume slider.
[*] Reduced the base volume of the hover sound.
[*] Fixed the same issue for the loading screen opening/closing sounds.
[*] Fixed flickering card details in the deck building popup on certain screen resolutions.
[/list]

Thanks for all the support and feedback, I hope you are enjoying the demo! If you find any issue or have any suggestion please don't hesitate to let us now! Let's make the game better together <3
God bless you and have a good week!

notes.title: Development update #7 - Translations
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Welcome to the 7th development update of Iconia Defenders! I think i'm getting used to make these posts...

Today I come with what may look like a little update, but oh dear, it was a lot of work.
We started to work on game translations! And we have implemented various languages for the current game's content:
French
Spanish
Italian
Portuguese
German
Russian
Polish
Japanese
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chinese
Korean

This required not only to translate the strings of the game, but to adapt it to be more resilient to the differences in size and shape of each language.

This is the information panel of the skill tree in 3 different languages:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/286b166e6f568d4a94eac9cb7246a60102855e1e.png[/img]

You may also noticed that the store page is translated now, so everyone can see the store page in their native language. Well, only those which language is one of the ones mentioned above.

As I mentioned, the amount of work was pretty big. Between translations, making tools, fixing UIs, and trying to review that everything is correct, a whole week of development went away at the speed of light (maybe a bit more). Was it worth it? Yes, specially that now we know which things to consider for the next time.

Please keep in mind that some translations may be incorrect or perhaps incomplete, If you find anything that is not correctly translated, let us know! And we will work on it.

Thanks for reading!! God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Development update #6 - Skill Tree
notes.notes:
Welcome everybody to our 6th development update! Today I'm going to talk about a new exiting and fundamental feature of the game: 
the [b]skill tree[/b]! Yep, the one that you were able to take a sneak peak in the previous update!

[h1]Skill Tree[/h1]

We have implemented the skill tree in the game. Featuring the Tree of Life in the background, and the skills in the front. Here we will be able to exchange the gems we gathered on previous runs for new cards and upgrades for the towers. We will even be able to unlock some cool mechanics! Like leveling up towers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/1fa0655643677848935b5532fa2d5c588a5fcad3.gif[/img]

As you can see, it is really big. For the 1.0 release it will feature more than 150 skills, waiting for you to be discovered.
The skills are divided by "Sections" or "Tiers". Where every tier provides a new set of upgrades for the different towers, as well as cards, and a set of 4 superior gems that can appear at the end of every wave survived.

But that's not all, at the left of the screen, there is a panel where we can review different stats of our journey, our highest wave, and our progress in the skill tree.

[h1]Roadmap update[/h1]

We have achieved a new milestone in our roadmap! aye! The next step is implementing achievements. But before diving right on them, there are various things to do first, which you will be hearing about in our upcoming development updates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/8c12ce264ab3f5f1e1221d1195526a6cbfac368a.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks![/h1]

Thank you very much for reading and willing to stay up to date with the game updates! More is to come soon, stay tuned!

God bless you all, and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Development update #5 - Deck building
notes.notes:
Ey everybody! Welcome to your 5th development update of Iconia Defenders!

Today I'm going to talk about one of our core game features, which we just implemented in the last weeks. 

[h1]Deck Building[/h1]

The Starter Deck Building mechanic is done! Here is a little gif :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/8b1567bcbb33006470bcb2ef13a6ccb3d979175e.gif[/img]

Before starting a new run, we are now able to choose a starter deck. Which basically determines the towers, walls, and spells that we can play. It is limited tho, so pick those that will adapt better to your strategy! And Don't worry! the selection is not permanent, because through the run, new cards can appear as rewards for certain superior gems.

However, there are superior gems that requires you to have certain cards in your deck. For example, if you want to get superior gems that enhances the fire mage's skills, then you will need to have at least 1 fire mage card in the deck.

There are many superior gems that are exclusive to each type of tower. As well as superior gems that requires a certain combination of them. For example, [i]"Incendiary Arrows"[/i] requires you to have both, an archer tower, and a fire mage tower cards.

[h1]Roadmap update[/h1]

With that being said, I want to announce that this achieves another milestone in our development roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/877e40ba10a30d3e8ce5334f75201ce7d3a3d065.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks![/h1]

And that's it for this update. Thank you very much for reading, and if you didn't whislisted & followed the game yet, what are you waiting for? More is to come soon! If you paid attention to the gif, there is a little sneak peak to the skill tree behind it, but we will comment more about it in another update.

God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Development update #4
notes.notes:
Hello hello! Welcome to our 4th development update of Iconia Defenders!

It's been a while since the last update, so this time I come with some news about what was going on in the last month. 
This was particularly a huge chunk of work: We started to implement the story. We completed the tutorial, and also implemented various menu screens. We also started an official internal playtesting. 
So let's dive in it!

[h2]Story & Tutorial[/h2]
The plot goes like this:
[i]
The Tree of Life is being consumed by a malevolent force known as the Corruption, you are an eternal hero tasked with healing its branches. Stripped of your memories and powers by a sacrificial act, you now wield the Gem Extractor, the only tool that can remove the corruption from the roots of the world. It is your duty to protect it from the inhabitants of Iconia, which are being controlled by the corruption itself as a self-defense mechanism from you. 
Each defeat brings you back to the Tree's roots, where it restores fragments of your past. Your mission: purify the Tree's timelines, for each failed attempt leaves a branch doomed to corruption. 

Embrace your destiny, reclaim your power, and save the timelines from a dark fate!
[/i]
How everything is connected? Well, that's up to you to discover when the time comes! For the story-telling and different events in the game we have implemented a dialogue-based conversation, as shown in the following image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/169f51e824359d538668f1f0e5e124df730543f5.png[/img]

In the same way, we have implemented the tutorial, that will guide you to grasp the basics.

[h2]Game Tips[/h2]

A lot of work was put on the UI, we implemented in-game tips for specific tips about certain mechanics not present in the tutorial. As you can see in the following picture:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/7ee6179ac04bdb6e50a971c8993273985ba9ae75.png[/img]

At the same time, we have enemy information popups when discovering a new type of enemy. Which will include some stats and info about their skills:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/746a21adf5fb792f65485dfed70f133446d76739.png[/img]

Both the enemy information and game tips appear as notifications of the left side of the screen. So they will not disturb your game, and you can open them at any time. For example, in the picture above there is a game tip notification that I didn't open yet.

In addition to that, we have implemented the whole main menu screen, settings screen, In-game menu (pressing ESC key), and also played around with some tools and mechanics.

[h2]Internal playtesting[/h2]

We began to do an official [b]internal[/b] playtesting with a playable mini demo, to tweak the different parts of the gameplay and find specific issues. However, since you have reach this text, and as the wonderful follower that you are, feel free to contact us or leave a comment to participate in it!

[h2]Thanks![/h2]

This was fun and I learnt a lot of new stuff. so if you reached this part, cool! It is a pleasure to share this adventure with you. And As I mentioned in previous updates, if there is any question or suggestion, don't be shy and let us know! I will be happy to read it.

God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Development update #3
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, welcome to our 3rd development update of Iconia Defenders! 

These weeks have been very busy. Tasks ended up being bigger than expected, but here we are! Progressing through the second milestone of the development roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/371c7d800843023506c1c5601f26253292b485a5.png[/img]

You may notice that we moved the achievements to the end, honestly it didn't make sense to make them before the other 2 core mechanics of the game (skill tree & deck building menu). Now the path forward is much clearer

[h2]1st boss![/h2]
We were working on the first boss of the game: [i]Bharisia, The WItch[/i].
During her attack, the creeps will not stop coming. That means tons of enemies! Together, with the witch, they represent a big challenge if the maze wasn't built with caution.

Using her broom, Bharisia will fly around the map a couple times before trying to approach the player's base. She will throw magical spells to the towers from time to time, stunning them for some seconds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/2a31f546b632fee5f4a4dd9b60ff156f18caa88d.gif[/img]

We have also created the "boss health bar". That gives the importance she deserves (sorry, no picture for this!).
But that's not all! Bharisia is a [b]two stage boss[/b]. So, when defeated, she will respawn somewhere in the map, angry, because you broke her broom!

[h2]Superior Gems[/h2]
We finally implemented the beloved Superior Gems! These are rewards which you will have to choose when completing a wave. They will greatly enhance your defenses or even provide new cards to play,  which are fundamental to continue surviving the hordes of enemies. 
We have implemented more than 40 superior gems! Here are some of them, in full HD, so they are easy to read (you may need to click them).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/d67a8b8b4fa5bce969c041cb1c4ffa453a85e8bc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/cdbf30cfd11cfeb54f4ed8a1698b567629eb302f.png[/img]

[h2]Cursed Gems[/h2]
Not everything that shines are beautiful gems. Every 3rd wave you will have to choose a cursed gem, which will increase the game difficulty by tweaking the enemies, adding powers to them, adding cursed cards to your deck, and more. 
Be careful and design your strategy well as your choice will carry through the whole run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/fc9d76e4e68c969a834fb6a25495f5dd1f3d3829.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/524431381faf68ba5ef10178862c6566bfd8af85.png[/img]

[h2]Gems in action[/h2]
Here are some creeps teleporting when receiving a hit, and there is even a golden shaman! (2 cursed gems combined)
You can also take a peek to the incendiary arrows fired by the archer, thanks to the "Incendiary arrows" superior gem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/1fc4a3a93c9f6d627282ecd3a846d0875dbe6478.gif[/img]

[h2]Thanks![/h2]
This update was a big big chunk of work in our timelines, the boss ended up being harder than expected, but I learnt so many things and prepared a diverse set of tools to speed up the upcoming features. 
If you reached here, congrats! I'm glad that you did and I thank you getting on this trip together with us!

If you have any feedback or suggestion leave a comment or feel free to contact us

God bless you all and have a wonderful week!

notes.title: Development update #2
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, welcome to our 2nd development update of Iconia Defenders! I hope you are all having a great week!

We have a couple things to share since the last update, so let's go straight to them

[h2]Mini Boss Portals[/h2]
Remember what we talked about portals in the previous announcement? Well, let me show you the Mini-boss portals! These are bigger and have a different color as well as a different path indicator to illustrate the danger they represent
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/01f64082422ab4345d6c1757d560ba166512b0a2.gif[/img]

[h2]But wait, what is a Mini-boss?[/h2]
Mini-bosses are stronger versions of the enemies that appears every X waves (5 for the moment) followed by their own personal entourage. They are bigger and definitely more resistant than their regular versions, and they also have their own life bar and a cool helmet!
Here are two examples:

[h3]The Goblin Chief[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/5aa38b0a07932d637ba4a8812f949a9285d923de.gif[/img]

[h3]The Orc Commander[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/c46f2b30f011d0c0eac97995a64688c6c74ea636.gif[/img]

[h2]Shaman Creeps[/h2]
Introducing the [b]shamans[/b], these guys have a bunch of health and are highly resistant to magic. So be careful and make good use of your physical towers! That's not all, they can heal surrounding creeps and also themselves from time to time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/5e7bd82087a604626b4e536949e6267197ccd063.gif[/img]

[h2]Tower Upgrades[/h2]
In order to survive against our new friends, we need not only to place more defenses but also to improve the ones that we have built before. And doing so is as easy as clicking a button. As long as you have enough money!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/7e3bdf9f74436f17b0bc580d4eb2e0ea3386a58b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/13e68acb896aca487e2634f27c04026acf8041ab.gif[/img]

As you may notice, the towers have a number below their icon, which indicates their current level.

[h2]Thanks![/h2]
And that's it for this update! Thank you very much for reading till here. There are still many things to work on, but we are on the way!

God bless you all and have a wonderful weekend!

notes.title: Development Roadmap & First Dev Update
notes.notes:
Ey everybody, welcome to Iconia Defenders 1st announcement, I hope you all are having a great week!

Before going further, we want to thank you all for reaching this post, and even more if you wishlisted the game. That means a lot for us. And it is a great source of motivation!

We have a couple things to share, one is to showcase our development roadmap for the upcoming months, which you can see in the following picture:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/8e5b2dbef32611b30bc0a54df4f68e9b72257d51.png[/img]

As you can see, it is not a complete end-to-end roadmap, but rather a near-future roadmap. We are right at the beginning, finishing up the details for the core gameplay. Like enemies, drawing cards for gold, the 6 primary tower types, the endless wave system, and ensuring everything works as smooth as possible.

We've got portals! At the beginning of each wave, a new set of portals is opened in the world, creeps will begin to appear once the preparation time finishes. You don't know the order nor how many enemies will come from those places, but you do know where they are going! So take advantage of that! There are 2 types of paths, which will let you know if there are flying or ground enemies coming out from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/694463c5a5f0ffdff67d0e9d5728bf3fcc9870c4.gif[/img]

And talking about enemies, we have just finished the flying creeps system. Starting with bats, flying creeps will go through your defenses directly to the your base, and it is your duty to prepare your defenses to kill these creatures, and be sure they won't get distracted with the ground ones! Take a look at the next gif to see the bats in action. They may look cute and small, but as you advance through the waves, new and ferocious creatures will start to appear in the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/20717ac98d0002126b93630d5a2513835e1bae74.png[/img]

Before the flying creeps attack, you will see a path of feathers coming from the portal to the base to indicate where they are coming from. if you don't see the feathers, then you can rest assured you won't see any flying creature, at least on the current wave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891800/a913f80a31bf431252202696f710deda6d8e85bd.png[/img]

And that's it for this announcement, there is still a lot of work to do, and as mentioned before, the roadmap doesn't display all of the things we are working on. For example, we are also working in many designs for the upcoming features, and setting up the translation system. Anyways it does show what is coming and where we are. 

If you have any question or feedback, leave a comment! I would love to read it! 

Thanks again for reading,
Rodrigo Soria - Anawim Studios.
